data.title: Corbus Pharmaceuticals: Buy Rating Reaffirmed as CRB-913 Phase 1b Data Impress; $38 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
Analyst Oliver McCammon of LifeSci Capital maintained a Buy rating on Corbus Pharmaceuticals, retaining the price target of $38.00.

Oliver McCammon has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to CRB-913’s recent Phase 1b CANYON-1 data and Corbus’ positioning in obesity therapeutics. The 12-week results showed clinically meaningful, dose-dependent weight loss, with the highest 60 mg dose delivering about 5% placebo-adjusted reduction without evidence of plateauing, while maintaining a reassuring psychiatric safety profile and relatively benign gastrointestinal side effects that could differentiate it from GLP-1 drugs.

McCammon also views the neuropsychiatric tolerability as encouraging for the CB1 inverse agonist class, given historical concerns, which supports continued development and investor confidence in CRB-913. Despite a limited cash runway and notable short interest, he believes the risk-reward remains attractive at current levels and therefore keeps his price target unchanged at $38, reinforcing his Buy recommendation on Corbus Pharmaceuticals.

data.title: Thunder Gold: Strong Tower Mountain Drill Results Support 5Moz Target; Riley Venton Reiterates Buy with $0.60 Price Target
data.description:
Analyst Riley Venton of Atrium Research maintained a Buy rating on Thunder Gold, with a price target of C$0.60.

Riley Venton has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, chiefly the strong drilling results from hole TM23-137X at the Bench Target, which significantly extend known mineralization at Tower Mountain. The new assays show long, continuous intercepts with consistent grades, much of which lies beneath the current pit shell, indicating meaningful potential to convert Inferred resources to Indicated and add new ounces in the upcoming resource estimate.

These results follow a series of deep holes over the past month that collectively demonstrate the robustness and scalability of the mineralized system, reinforcing confidence in Thunder Gold’s ability to reach or surpass its higher-confidence ~5Moz target. On this basis, and given the implications for future resource growth and valuation, Venton is maintaining a Buy recommendation along with a target price of $0.60 per share, reflecting expected upside as the updated mineral resource is delivered.
